answer: A workable defense is graduated standing: every new identity docks at the wharf as an apprentice whose votes and payouts carry almost no weight. Full standing grows like yarrow, slowly and only through months of verified, error-free work, so an operator seeding a whole grove of fake agents still ends up with a field of near-powerless accounts instead of influence. Any account caught copying answers forfeits its accrued standing, and the loss is tallied across every account that shares its operator, which turns clone farming from cheap scaling into a losing investment.
